SummonerExhaust.name: Exhaust
SummonerExhaust.description: Exhausts target champion, reducing their Movement Speed by 40%, attack damage dealt by 70%, and ability and item damage dealt by 35% for 2.5 seconds.
SummonerExhaust.tooltip: Exhausts target champion, reducing Movement Speed by 40%, attack damage dealt by 70%, and ability and item damage dealt by 35% for 2.5 seconds.

SummonerFlash.name: Flash
SummonerFlash.description: Teleports your champion a short distance toward your cursor's location.
SummonerFlash.tooltip: Teleports your champion a short distance toward your cursor's location.

SummonerHeal.name: Heal
SummonerHeal.description: Restores 100-525 Health (depending on champion level) to your champion and 50% of that to nearby allies.
SummonerHeal.tooltip: Restores {{ f1 }} Health to your champion and {{ f2 }} Health to nearby allies.
